headline: 3 children die with measles symptoms in Sylhet
summary: The deaths of three children showing symptoms of the disease have raised concerns over a potential outbreak in the region.
details: Three children have died in Sylhet showing symptoms of measles, according to reports.
The deaths have occurred in the Sylhet region, highlighting the risk of the disease's spread among children.
Health authorities are monitoring the situation to prevent further fatalities and ensure vaccination coverage.
The incidents underscore the importance of timely vaccination to protect children from measles, a highly contagious viral disease.

headline: BMD warns of heavy rainfall and waterlogging in parts of Dhaka
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department predicts heavy to very heavy rain over the next 48 hours across several divisions, including the capital.
details: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has issued a special bulletin warning of heavy to very heavy rainfall in several divisions over the next 48 hours.
